    • httpClient

      public OkHttpPlatformClient.Builder httpClient(okhttp3.OkHttpClient httpClient)
      An OkHttpClient to send with instead of the client's own. Its timeouts, proxy and TLS configuration apply to token requests and API calls alike, and it is not shut down on OkHttpPlatformClient.close(). Its interceptors see both, with the credentials attached; its Authenticator is replaced on API calls by the one that renews the access token.

    • userAgent

      public OkHttpPlatformClient.Builder userAgent(String userAgent)
      The User-Agent sent on every request. Defaults to bilt-pos-sdk/<version>.

    • refreshSkew

      public OkHttpPlatformClient.Builder refreshSkew(Duration refreshSkew)
      How long before a token's expiry its background refresh starts. Defaults to 60 seconds. A token that lives shorter than the skew is simply used until it expires.
